name: aphrody
description: Aphrody agent toolkit usable in any project: skills, agents and commands for Rust/Bun engineering, web research, AI/RAG, reverse engineering, Windows/Linux administration, Material 3 UI, NIE and Dragon Ball/Shenron, plus the optional aphrody-kernel MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Aphrody skills, agents and kernel MCP for any project.
interface.longDescription: Aphrody skills, agents and commands for Rust/Bun engineering, web research, AI/RAG, reverse engineering, system administration, UI and Dragon Ball/Shenron, usable from any repository. When aphrody-kernel is installed (or APHRODY_KERNEL_BIN points at it), the plugin connects to its single MCP endpoint; without it the skills and agents still load. Secrets remain in the host environment.
defaultPrompt: Use the Aphrody AI, RAG or local model workflow for this task.
Research a Dragon Ball question with cited sources and check canon separately.
Use the Aphrody kernel tools for the requested operating-system capability.
